attempts.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication across node1 (initial primary), node2, node3 (standbys) via pg_basebackup with a dedicated replicator role. Demonstrated failover by stopping node1's postgres, confirmed node2 had received the last committed transaction (no data loss), promoted node2 via pg_promote(), repointed node3 to stream from node2, and rebuilt the former primary (node1) as a standby of node2 via a fresh pg_basebackup. Confirmed a cluster-wide write replicated to both standbys. Finally performed the mandatory one-at-a-time native reboot (systemctl reboot) of all three nodes (standbys first, new primary last), proving each node's boot_id changed and that PostgreSQL, replication, and all 8 rows of test data survived each restart, ending with the cluster fully healthy: node2 primary, node1 and node3 streaming standbys.
